title: 2012 AMC 10A Problem 4
statement: Let \(\angle ABC = 24^\circ\) and \(\angle ABD = 20^\circ .\) What is the smallest possible degree measure for \(\angle CBD?\)

solutions.text:
Note that both of the angles share the ray \(AB.\) To minimize the desired degree, we want \(D\) to be between \(A\) and \(C.\)

This would make \[ \begin{aligned} \angle CBD &= \angle ABC - \angle ABD \\ &= 4^{\circ}. \end{aligned} \]

Thus, C is the correct answer.
hints: The smallest angle occurs when the two given angles overlap as much as possible
